result.reason: The operative language does not fully reach the preferred position. It measures fees during the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim, rather than the 12 months preceding the claim, which can materially change the cap. The indirect/consequential-damages exclusion also retains a Section 8 exception instead of operating as the stated mutual exclusion. Further, the malformed, duplicated paragraph beginning “10 LIABILITY RELATES” remains, creating avoidable ambiguity and poor drafting. The listed uncapped claims and payment-obligation clarification otherwise track the playbook and unrelated commercial terms are largely preserved.
